name: Reetha Herbal 100g Hair Pack
original_description:
Khoobsurat Reetha Herbal Hair Pack is a celebration of nature’s gifts, tailored to enhance the beauty and vitality of your hair. Reetha, also known as soapnut, is renowned for its gentle cleansing properties and natural conditioning effects. This herbal hair pack combines the wonders of Reetha with a selection of herbal ingredients, carefully chosen to promote hair health and enrich your natural beauty. Reetha or soap nut is quite a popular natural product which is extensively used in the natural hair care. Reetha is a round wrinkly fruit with a round black hard nut inside. The outer skin is reddish brown in color and is used in the hair care products like shampoos, conditioners etc.

Benefits of Reetha Herbal  Hair Pack.

  • Gentle Cleansing: Reetha and Shikakai naturally cleanse the hair and maintain its essential oils.
  • Hair Strengthening: Bhringraj and Amla strengthen hair from the roots, reducing hair fall and promoting growth.
  • Scalp Health: The herbal ingredients help maintain a clean and healthy scalp, reducing dandruff and itchiness.
  • Natural Shine: The herbal ingredients add a natural shine and gloss to your hair, leaving it looking healthier and more vibrant.
